# CraftLeaf & Stardust Studio (青叶星尘独立工坊)

> Privacy-first 100% client-side browser micro-tools, zero-telemetry open-source IDE & browser extensions, original Print-and-Play tabletop strategy games, and bilingual North American newcomer survival guides. Zero user files or secrets are ever uploaded to a server.

- Portal: https://963239327.github.io/craftleaf-studio/
- Short Root URL: https://963239327.github.io/
- Digital Storefront (27 Products & Lifetime Passes): https://stardustdemo.gumroad.com
- Playable Tabletop Showcase: https://stardustdemo.itch.io
